# T-4: Surface schema errors via gate envelope and retry counter

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
When parseGuardrailArticleEvaluation throws EvaluationSchemaError inside the gate command, the gate emits envelope {ok:false, errors[0].code: 'EVALUATION_SCHEMA_ERROR'} with the parser message in errors[0].messages, increments the gate retry counter (one slot consumed), and writes an issue-log entry equivalent to a normal FAIL.

## Acceptance Criteria
- On EvaluationSchemaError caught from parseGuardrailArticleEvaluation, the gate command returns Envelope.fail with errors[0].code === 'EVALUATION_SCHEMA_ERROR'.
- errors[0].messages contains the parser-thrown message (offending entry + field).
- Gate retry counter (gateRetry per RETRY_TRACKED_PHASES phase) is incremented by 1.
- An issue-log entry is appended via appendIssueLogFromGateError or equivalent path.
- Mocked-agent test asserts the envelope shape and the counter increment.

## Implementation Notes
Update EvaluationSchemaError constructor (run-gate.js:692) to set `this.code = 'EVALUATION_SCHEMA_ERROR'` so the dispatcher's err.code mapping resolves to the same code if it ever leaks past the catch. Hook into the existing try/catch around the AI call inside the gate command (run-gate.js's runGateFlow / executeSpec / executeDraft / executeTaskSpec / executeDiffBasedGate) — catch EvaluationSchemaError BEFORE returning to the dispatcher. Inside the catch: (a) call updateGateRetryCounter(ctx, 'fail') manually (since dispatcher post-hooks are skipped on ok:false); (b) call appendIssueLogFromGateError with a synthesized message; (c) return Envelope.fail with errors[0].code='EVALUATION_SCHEMA_ERROR'. This mirrors the existing handling for ESCALATE_REPEATED_FAIL / NO_PROGRESS_SINCE_LAST_FAIL paths.

## Test Strategy
Mocked-agent gate test: configure agent to return JSON with FAIL and empty violations[]; assert envelope shape and counter increment.
